sourceNote: The T-pose pig mesh of the user, of 2026-10-24, with no edit (assets/models/pig/README.md). The user said: "replace the pig model with [...] pig_tpose [...]". The arms of the T-pose are free of the trunk, so the rig keeps each face of the mesh: no cut, no copy, no ring, and no split.
name: Pig

app.note: The pig keeps the size of the pig mesh before it: 1.2 m for each unit, the head top at 1.2 m. The reach is the reach of the arm factor below.

armFactorNote: The factor that gives the reach of the pig mesh before it (0.3845 m), so that the paws reach the horn as before. The factor 1.5 of that mesh gives 0.42 m on this mesh.

upperTwist.note: The twist bone of each upper arm keeps 0.4 of the roll of the upper arm from the chest (StudioBody.upperTwist), the share of the hippo and the rhino. The user chose it with the new upper arms on 2026-10-21: the twist p95 of the arm gate falls from 48 to 39 degrees on the left and to 35 on the right (docs/research/2026-10-21-arm-form.md).

jointsNote: The places are in the units and the axes of the studio in the pose of the source: 1 unit from the soles to the head top, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The probes are in docs/research/2026-10-24-pig-tpose/. The legs part below y 0.16, and the thigh joint lies inside the haunch. The neck is narrowest at y 0.67, and the big head starts there. The floppy ears stand out to the sides from y 0.88. The arms are in a T-pose: each round arm goes out level at y 0.59 and a little back, free of the trunk beyond x 0.17, to the hoof at x 0.41 (sections-x.txt, arm-axis.txt). The elbow lies halfway to the wrist, the wrist where the hoof starts, and the forearm twist between them. The curly tail sits behind the rump at y 0.29 to 0.35. In the T-pose, the sole of the hoof faces down and a little forward. Of four palms near down (gate-variants.txt), this one gives the least twist in the arm gate.

studio.note: The studio has no pig. legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind pose to the source, and the right side mirrors it. The posture is the seated posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down from the hip to the knee, the thighs turn 15 degrees out, so that the horn has room at the right knee, and the shin is vertical (docs/research/2026-10-16-hip-open/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 0). The foot and the toes keep the turn of the source, so that the soles stand flat on the floor. The source shin slants 7.6 degrees back. The trunk shares and the bind arms are the values of the cat, the dog, the panda, the hippo, and the mouse.

armFree.note: The arm of the T-pose is free of the trunk beyond x 0.17, from y 0.54 to 0.65 (sections-x.txt). A vertex of the free arm lies beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, within radius of the chain of the arm joints, and above the floor.

line.note: The angle of the other meshes of 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24: a lower angle mixes the weights of long arm faces.

weights.note: Beyond the plane of armSplit (armFree), only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom, each vertex follows the head only, the ears too (earBase above the head). The curly tail is a ball on one bone (tailBall). armTop starts above the top of the level arms (y 0.65). The rig has no cut, no ring, and no split (user, 2026-10-23).

flip.note: The values of the fox, the rabbit, the cat, the dog, the panda, the hippo, and the mouse.

check.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, the panda, the hippo, and the mouse.

colors.note: The values of samples, palette, and eyeShare are the values of the other meshes. The pink snout has no dark nose, so the pig has no nose box, as the pig mesh before it.

eyeShell.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, the hippo, and the mouse.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail. The half width holds the haunch of the pig (x 0.22). The short thighs lie under the round belly, so the front edge lies behind them. The back edge holds the back of the haunch.

crease.note: The values of the cat, the dog, the panda, the hippo, and the mouse.

sit.note: The values of the panda, the hippo, and the mouse.
